item.description: The day of March 15 never ended for Sara Qasem, who lost her father in the Christchurch mosque attacks. On the seventh anniversary, she writes about how that day changed the way she reads the world. Some days the news arrives like smoke– thin at first, then everywhere. Every March in Christchurch, the light changes slightly. I know this by the fasting window in Ramadan this year. item.description: From ‘otai to Cook Islands drumming, there was plenty to love at Auckland’s Pasifika Festival. item.description: Jai Breitnauer’s son has attended mainstream and specialist schools. As NZ plans two new specialist schools, she warns they are not a silver bullet.
